index.title: Unsubscribe from Unwanted Marketing Emails
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Unsubscribe Unwanted. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Unsubscribe from Unwanted Marketing Emails. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person filtered unwanted marketing emails in their email account, sent an unsubscribe link to a recipient, waited for confirmation, and then used the recipient's email provider to send an unsubscribe request. This job is the public patter
